name: Cheat Engine（KSword 后端）
description: Runs 64-bit Cheat Engine in its own window with a reusable KSword memory/debugger backend, the complete current HVM protocol API, EPT breakpoint integration, and a themed KSword log Tab with an HVM switch.

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Verify KSword R0, initialize the x64 debugger backend and open the selected process.

commands.name: tab
commands.description: Open standalone 64-bit Cheat Engine and a KSword log Tab with an HVM backend switch.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check whether the KSword R0 device is available without showing UI.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Print plugin capabilities and payload readiness as JSON Lines.
